card.name: Spaces between columns in command output
card.fires_on: The space between number columns in pasted terminal output such as ps, ls -l and disklabel listings. Also fires on a space inside a table of numbers.

modes.label: Unix listings
modes.description: Gap between numeric columns in ps, ls -l or partition table output.

modes.label: Dose table numbers
modes.description: Gap inside a numeric table beside a bracketed number.

card.plain: It fires on the gaps between number columns in computer command printouts and some number tables.
